captcha_challenges.title: CAPTCHA #01 · Sideways 74×43 Horizontal Hand (89° Off Forearm Bone Axis)
captcha_challenges.symptom_summary: The left hand cut-out (`74×43 px` horizontal card) sticks out sideways at 89° from the wrist like a broken fin instead of extending along the forearm.
captcha_challenges.measured_defect: Card long axis is horizontal (+X, 74px wide × 43px tall) while the forearm bone runs vertically (+Y). Naive placement sets rotation offset = 0° and pivot at [0.50, 0.18], producing an 89.2° axial error (`FAILINGS.md §5`).

diagnostic_options.text: The 74×43 hand card was cut horizontally (wrist on left, fingers right) and placed with 0° rotation offset instead of +90° bone-axis alignment and [0.22, 0.48] wrist pin.
The shoulder 2-bone IK pole vector is inverted behind the spine.
The torso neck socket is missing its Z-order depth offset.
The camera focal length is set to orthographic projection.

captcha_challenges.solver_explanation: `fit_bone(pivot_A, socket_B, wrist, tip)` measures the card's internal vector `cv = socket_B - pivot_A` (`[0.66, 0.02]`, horizontal) and rotates by `aw - ac` (`+90°`), pinning `pivot_A = [0.22, 0.48]` directly inside the sleeve cuff.

captcha_challenges.title: CAPTCHA #12 · Rigid Single-Card Skirt / Dress Colliding with High Knee in Stair Climb

captcha_challenges.measured_defect: Exact `FAILINGS.md §2` defect: 'The skirt is one rigid card: 780 frames put her knees through it.' The pelvis/skirt card stayed locked at `0°` vertical pitch while `thigh_R` flexed to `+48°`.

diagnostic_options.text: The rigid `skirt.png` card is locked at 0° vertical while the knee rises through it; it needs the articulated `body.profile.pelvis.png` card coupled to `0.45 * max(thigh_flex)` drape pitch.
The staircase riser height is negative.
The Woman's head scale is set to child 5.2H.
The wrist cuff clip ratio is too small.
